faqs.q: Sec. 102-162. - Waiver by city council—Water system development charges.
faqs.a:
Water system development charges for residential, commercial, institutional, governmental
               and industrial uses applicable within the city limits, and outside the city limits,
               may be waived or reduced only by express city council approval upon a finding and
               determination by the city council that such waiver or reduction is in the best interest
               of the city.
(Code 1981, § 33-78; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988; Ord. No. 4819, § 19, 10-17-2022,
               eff. 7-1-2023; Ord. No.
4854
, § 4, 9-11-2023)
